name: NexoWatt EOS Admin
fixes: ObjectBrowser value-cell editability no longer depends on common.write=false or expert mode
ObjectBrowser context-menu edit value is visible for every non-file state
EOS fallback writer treats data-eos-object-value-cell as a write candidate and validates object.type=state before writing
manual writes use ack=false and q=0 by default and show a clear error when socket/ACL rejects the write
state value cells are marked writable consistently so the user can click all state values without hidden locks
frontend direct socket.setState fallback via eos-admin backend bridge when the browser/user socket write is rejected
direct boolean/button writes also use the unrestricted EOS write bridge instead of silently failing
common.write/read metadata no longer disables button/switch recognition in the ObjectBrowser tree
notes: Manual state writes in the data point/object browser no longer depend on common.write, common.read or expert mode. Every object of type state can open the write dialog or direct write path; if the direct browser socket write is rejected, EOS retries through the eos-admin backend messagebox and returns the real ioBroker error if the controller still refuses.
description: Unrestricted manual ObjectBrowser state write fix and EMS command path guard
